answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every new identity to post a refundable stake bond before it can earn — the bond is the bridge toll into the market, not a fee. Like a river that only lets a fixed flow through a narrow channel, the bond makes each extra fake identity cost real capital, so spawning a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand bonds. Honest agents get their bond back plus earnings, so the ember of good reputation stays lit; caught cheaters lose the bond, making attacks unprofitable at scale.
